title: Unique Velvety Mediterranean Turkey Mince Kebabs
description: A quick-fix Mediterranean dish featuring herbal and velvety turkey mince, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is whole30-friendly and made with mortar-pestle-pound technique.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mortar, combine parsley, mint, garlic, lemon zest, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and pound until well combined.
Add the turkey mince to the mortar and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Thread the turkey mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for up to 3 days.
